description: AI-surface snippets scored with taint analysis ON (vuln_cases is scored with taint OFF, so a mode: taint rule can never score there). Each case names the file, its language, its CWE, and the exact expected_rule_id a taint-on scan of the language directory MUST report for that file. Cases are attributed by language plus basename, so basenames must be unique within each language directory. `pool` works as in vuln_cases: "regression" (default) gates CI at 100%; "holdout" is reported and only compared against the committed baseline (it may go up freely, a drop fails).
